answers.goal: I want to be a talent agent and champion creatives.
answers.drew: I just love art - in all its forms! Working in the entertainment industry would allow me to be close to the creative projects that I care about. I specifically want to work in talent representation and help creatives achieve their goals.
answers.seeking: People that are truly passionate, determined, and believe in the power of art and entertainment!
answers.inspiration: Probably all the motivated women in the industry - the ones working towards their goals right now, the ones that are achieving them, and the ones that are long gone. That is what keeps me motivated and hopeful!
